page.overview:
Who is Darth Vitus?

Darth Vitus was an individual who became a Sith at which point he was considered an ancient Sith. After gaining significant knowledge of how to utilize Sith alchemy, he desired to develop his understanding of the subject further, so he carried out research at a compound on the moon Oricon in the Outer Rim Territories. During the course of his investigations, Vitus experimented on monsters that were strong in the dark side of the Force.

Darth Vitus was first mentioned in "Behind the Threat: The Sith (Part 5): Antiheroes," an article that was released by Wizards of the Coast published on Wizards.com and written by Matthew Grau.
